experience.heroImageAlt: Developer workspace with monitor, keyboard, and desk setup
experience.heroBody: For the past 2 years, I've lived at the intersection of pixel-perfect aesthetics and high-performance engineering. My journey is defined by a relentless pursuit of the unconventional in frontend architecture.
experience.timeline1Description: Leading the architectural overhaul of the primary dashboard using React 18 and Next.js. Improved Core Web Vitals by 40% through aggressive code splitting and component memoization.
experience.timeline2Description: Scaled a SaaS platform to 10k+ monthly active users. Specialized in creating highly interactive data visualization components using Recharts and Tailwind CSS.
experience.timeline3Description: Assisted in building mobile-responsive landing pages. Mastered CSS layouts and JavaScript fundamentals while working on various client-side projects.
experience.arsenalBody: My stack is focused on modern web standards, with a heavy emphasis on type-safety, performance, and maintainability.

about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I was born on November 9, 1985, in Vanadzor, Armenia. I studied at Mesrop Mashtots School No. 1 in Vanadzor before continuing my education at Vanadzor State Pedagogical University.
about.paragraph2: At the university, I studied in the Department of Preschool Pedagogy and Psychology. Over the past 3 years, I have been learning and working as a Frontend Developer, including 1 year of dedicated React study at AGBU.
about.education2: Vanadzor State Pedagogical University - Department of Preschool Pedagogy and Psychology
about.strength1: 3 years of learning and hands-on work as a Frontend Developer.
about.strength2: 1 year of dedicated React study at AGBU.
about.strength3: A background in pedagogy and psychology that supports thoughtful, user-centered interface work.
